citation.journal: Journal of Occupational and Environmental Hygiene

cited_by.title: Heat, silk press, keratin treatments and colour

record.population: Four professional keratin smoothing products applied to wigs on mannequins in a simulated salon
record.finding: Airborne formaldehyde averaged 0.08 to 3.47 ppm during blow-drying and 0.08 to 1.05 ppm during flat-ironing. Bulk samples held 11.5% formaldehyde in Brazilian Blowout, 8.3% in Global Keratin, 3% in Coppola and 0% in La Brasiliana, and other products that break down into formaldehyde were found in three of the four.
record.note: Simulation on wigs; exposure of salon workers and clients, not a health outcome.
